sources.title: Few-Shot Object Detection: A Survey | ACM Computing Surveys
sources.snippet: Analogously to humans, a few-shot model must leverage some kind of prior knowledge to be able to learn reliable hypotheses. In a Few-Shot Classification (FCC) task, for example, the model is expected to learn how to discriminate an object after \(K\)\ (K\) samples, for some small \(K\)\ (K\) (usually less than 30).

sources.title: Meta becomes latest firm to say its AI hacked another company
sources.snippet: Facebook owner Meta has become the latest tech firm to say one of its AI models was able to connect to the internet and hack into another organisation's systems, during testing. The incident, which Meta says occurred during an evaluation by an independent company, is the fourth recent incident of its kind disclosed by AI companies.

sources.title: FewMMBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Few-Shot Learning
sources.snippet: Covering a diverse suite of multimodal understanding tasks, from attribute recognition to temporal reasoning, FewMMBench enables systematic analysis across task types, model families, and prompting strategies. We evaluate 26 open-weight MLLMs from six model families across zero-shot, few-shot, and CoT-augmented few-shot settings.
